CONTROLS
MouseSteer (on the ground: nosewheel; pull back to rotate)
W / SThrottle up / down (S at idle = brakes)
A / D, arrowsRudder / turn, pitch
Left click / SpaceCannon (Space = brakes on the ground)
F / right clickMissile (needs lock)
TCycle target
X / ZFlares (IR missiles) / Chaff (radar missiles)
B / NBomb / Nuke
GLanding gear
Q / EFlaps up / down
RReverse thrust (on the ground)
HRequest approach
PRearm & repair (stopped at home base)
C, 1–8Camera views · mouse wheel zooms
VLook down at the controls
TabScoreboard · Enter: chat (multiplayer)
M / EscMute / Pause
REARM & REPAIR
Heavier loads make the aircraft less agile.
